confidence_notes: Model estimate; live listings were not checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately certain. Accommodation is least certain because July demand and Gion Matsuri festival nights can push rates well above typical levels. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the beer anchor (about 1.9x and 1.6x) because direct knowledge is weaker. Assumes about 150 JPY per USD, 10% consumption tax on dine-in food and drink, and that accommodation includes consumption tax and Kyoto's lodging tax. The FX observation came from search-result summaries of RBA pages; the RBA page itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink benchmarked against Tokyo and Osaka pricing; accommodation adjusted upward for Kyoto's high tourist demand in July.
